original_idea.body:
# Defense-in-Depth Layer Independence: Are Monitor Errors Correlated?

**Problem:** The Swiss-cheese model only works if layers fail independently. If two monitors miss the same attacks, stacking them gives far less safety than their numbers suggest.

**Direction:** Import common-cause failure analysis. Run several distinct cheap monitors over the same SHADE-Arena trajectories, record per-trajectory hit/miss, and compute miss correlation. Estimate true stacked FNR vs the naive independence assumption.

**Why it matters:** Tells control designers whether their layered defenses are genuinely independent, central to any safety case. Cheap meta-analysis, no lab infra.

**Relevant context:** Swiss Cheese Model (arXiv:2408.02205); correlated monitor evasion (arXiv:2510.09462).
